headline: Microsoft gives Copilot deeper access to Windows
standfirst: The AI assistant is getting new powers to control your PC and read your local files.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Microsoft revealed a major upgrade for Copilot. It can now access your local files and control Windows.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The company showed this off at its latest Windows and Surface event.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: This is part of their Hybrid Intelligence push. It relies on a mix of local and cloud processing.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: See how well the AI handles complex tasks across your operating system.

caption:
Microsoft is updating Copilot to have more control over your Windows PC files and settings.

The tech giant showcased this new capability at their recent Windows and Surface event. It is a big step toward their goal of Hybrid Intelligence, where your computer uses both cloud power and local data to get things done.

Do you like the idea of an AI assistant having direct access to your local files?
